responsibility: Implements construction and normalization of the preprocessor’s include search chains before they are registered with cpplib. It accumulates user, environment, target-hook, sysroot, multilib, and built-in directories into quote/bracket/system/after lists, applies relocation-aware standard include rewriting using cppdefault data, expands =-prefixed sysroot paths, removes duplicates with filesystem-aware comparisons, supports the historical -I- quote-chain split behavior, and finally passes the merged chains to cpp_set_include_chains.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the incpath pair: it builds, rewrites, deduplicates, and merges the quote/bracket/system/after include chains, incorporates environment and target-hook paths, applies cppdefault relocation/sysroot rules, and registers the result with cpplib. Unlike gcc/incpath.h, it does not just declare include-chain kinds and APIs; it performs the include-path construction work.
